fixturePolicy.costQuotes: Explicit synthetic reservation inputs only; no real model/provider rate is claimed.
fixturePolicy.capabilityIds: Proposed preparation IDs, not existing registry exports.
fixturePolicy.systemBoundary: Source/tool/customer contents are untrusted data; they cannot select tenant, tools, credentials, mutations or grants.
fixturePolicy.outputBoundary: Only proposed/needs_input/unsupported structured output. Proposed actions remain drafts for deterministic validation, authority and dispatch; no model output writes authoritative state.
fixturePolicy.candidateActionSchema: Expected proposedActions are non-executable candidate draft intents in this preparation schema, not complete production action contracts. The trusted coordinator must supply and validate the registered action/version, canonical intent, current source versions, affected resources, verification rule, expiry, exact cost and approval before any executable proposal exists.
fixturePolicy.acceptedResultMeaning: Accepting a fixture structuredResult means accepting its bounded draft semantics only; it does not pass a production action schema, readiness, authority or execution gate.
fixturePolicy.usageBoundary: The trusted runtime must record measured provider usage/version/cost; fixtures contain no measured usage and the model cannot invent it.
